publication.title: Two ornithodiran unguals from the Rhaetian bonebed of Warburg-Bonenburg (Germany): Possible evidence for dinosaurs and pterosaurs

locality.name: PBDB collection 275902: one kilometer north of the village of Bonenburg, city of Warburg; GPS as generalized central point. Exact geographic information on the excavations over the years is scarce, but a generalized central point of the excavated beds lies at 51° 33' 45.79" N 9° 2' 15.23" E.

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 275902 to Rhaetian with numeric bounds 205.7–201.4 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 95624; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 2068801 records Sauropodomorpha in collection 275902, linked by PBDB to reference 95624.
PBDB stores the original/identified name as Sauropodomorpha indet. and the accepted name as Sauropodomorpha.
